what_happened: Planning found the cited defect's actual origin is context/formats/plan-format.md:364, whose __FULL_SWEEP__ sub-case (b) hands planners a verbatim copy-pasteable 'verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 <source_dir>' -- reproduced failing with exit 2 'no deploy tree'. The research report attributed the mistake only to the script header's ambiguous silence. Clarifying the header alone would have left the live wrong instruction in place; the plan folds the origin-site fix into phase 3.

The primary edit target agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/verify-deploy.sh carries ~76 lines of pre-existing FOREIGN uncommitted work (the warn_advisory()/WARN-FINDING channel) not attributable to this task or to any of this cycle's dispatched siblings (428/469/414, all in plan phase). agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json likewise carries 4 lines of foreign modification. git-commit-scoped.sh stages at pathspec granularity only, so a commit of either file would sweep that work in. The plan encodes an explicit commit-scope decision gate in phase 2 defaulting to leaving the file uncommitted and reporting, and directs phase 3 to leave index-entries.json unstaged if foreign hunks persist.

Measuring the gate baseline during planning (verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4,22 at the repo root) revealed gate 3 doc-lint already FAILS from pre-existing deploy staleness, exit 1. Capturing that before writing the plan let every phase be specified as a differential --findings comparison plus an explicit exit-status check, instead of an exit-code assertion that would have been read as a false regression at implementation time.
